services.title: Everything on the outside of a building that needs cleaning.
services.lead: From routine upkeep to difficult jobs, we adapt the method, pressure and product to every surface.

items.title: Façade cleaning
items.desc: Stone, brick, render, concrete or cladding: we restore your buildings' original look and protect the value of your property.
points: Pressure and product matched to the surface
long: A façade dirtied by pollution, particulates and weather lowers the value of a building and gives occupants and visitors a poor impression. We clean every type of façade (natural stone, brick, render, concrete, cladding) with a technique suited to the surface: high pressure, hot water, low pressure with product, or soft cleaning for fragile materials.

Before every job, we check the condition of the surface to choose the right method and avoid any damage. The work area is marked off and secured, the surroundings are protected, and the job is scheduled to disturb occupants as little as possible.
includes: Surface assessment and test on a discreet area
Marking off and securing the work area
Protection of frames, glazing and surroundings
High pressure, hot water or low pressure depending on the material
Rinsing and clean-up of the surroundings at the end
Water-repellent or anti-soiling treatment as an option

items.title: Graffiti removal
items.desc: Tags, graffiti and fly-posting removed from any surface without damaging the material. A clean façade protects your brand image.
long: Graffiti left in place attracts more graffiti. The sooner it is removed, the simpler the cleaning and the better the surface is preserved. We remove tags, graffiti, posters and stickers from stone, brick, concrete, metal, wood, glass and street furniture.

The product and method are chosen according to the paint used and the porosity of the surface, so the graffiti disappears without leaving a ghost mark. After cleaning, an anti-graffiti coating can be applied to make future removals easier.
includes: Identification of the surface and the paint

items.title: Moss removal on walls and floors
items.desc: Moss, lichen, algae and green deposits removed from walls, terraces, courtyards, driveways and car parks, using biodegradable products.
long: Moss, lichen and algae settle on walls, terraces, courtyards, paths and car parks. They blacken surfaces, damage joints and make floors slippery: a real fall risk for occupants and the public.

We combine mechanical cleaning, with high pressure or a rotary surface cleaner, with a biodegradable curative treatment that works in depth. A water-repellent can then be applied to slow regrowth and protect the surface.
includes: Walls, terraces, courtyards, paths and car parks

items.title: Stain removal and floor cleaning
items.desc: Oil, grease, chewing gum, rust, tyre marks: car parks, pavements, pavers, slabs and entrances look clean again.
long: Oil, grease, chewing-gum and rust stains and tyre marks quickly make car parks, entrances and pavements look neglected. The longer they stay, the harder they are to remove.

We treat each stain with the right product, then clean the surface with hot high-pressure water for an even result. We work on pavers, slabs, concrete, asphalt and natural stone, outside opening hours if needed.
includes: Pavers, slabs, concrete, asphalt and stone

items.title: Repainting
items.desc: After cleaning, we repaint façades, walls and exterior surfaces for a sharp, long-lasting finish.
long: Cleaning sometimes reveals a damaged surface or worn paint. Instead of bringing in a second contractor, we repaint façades, walls, plinths and exterior surfaces straight away.
Preparation makes the result: cleaning, sanding, filling and protecting the surroundings before painting. We use exterior paints suited to the surface for a clean, durable finish.
includes: Cleaning and preparation of the surface
Protection of surroundings, frames and floors
Exterior paint suited to the surface
Site clean-up at the end of the job

items.title: Industrial cleaning
items.desc: Workshop and warehouse floors, loading docks, oil puddles and leaks: high-pressure cleaning that keeps your downtime to a minimum.
long: Workshop and warehouse floors, loading docks, storage areas, site surroundings: a clean industrial environment is safer, more pleasant, and reassures your customers and auditors.

We degrease with hot high-pressure water and deal with oil leaks and spills, including in emergencies. Our VCA-certified teams know the safety rules of industrial sites and organise their work outside production hours.
includes: Treatment of oil leaks and spills

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: GoboClean, J. Wielemansstraat 42, 1652 Beersel (Belgium), VAT BE 0799.936.135. Contact: info@goboclean.be.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: When you fill in the contact form: your name, your company, your email address, your phone number, the requested service and the content of your message.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: This data is used only to answer your request and prepare a quote (pre-contractual measures, Article 6.1.b GDPR). It is never sold or used for marketing without your consent.

sections.title: Recipients
sections.body: Our teams, and our email delivery provider (Resend), acting as a processor solely to transmit the messages.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.body: At most three years after our last exchange if no collaboration follows; in the case of a contract, the period required by our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, rectification, erasure or restriction of your data, and object to its processing, by writing to info@goboclean.be. You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (www.dataprotectionauthority.be).

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses no advertising cookies and no audience-measurement tool. A single technical cookie remembers the chosen language.
